# Pinned build tools for scripts/subset-plex-jp.mjs (SONA-181).
#
# The script installs these into a throwaway virtualenv with
# `pip install --require-hashes -r scripts/requirements-subset.txt`, so a
# re-uploaded or tampered PyPI file cannot quietly reshape the typefaces we
# ship. Every published file of each pinned version is listed, so the install
# works on whatever platform the contributor is on.
#
# To move a version: bump it below and regenerate the hashes from PyPI's file
# list for that version (each entry's digests.sha256).
